messages.subject: Issues installing natverse
parts:
Hello,

When installing natverse with natmanager::install('natverse') I have been facing issues that I haven't been able to figure out: 

Error:                                                  
! error in pak subprocess
Caused by error in `stop_task_build(state, worker)`:
! Failed to build source package units.

I have already installed natmanager, installed XQuartz11, updated all other packages, made a github token and used it, but the installation still does not work for me. Is there something I am missing? Thank you so much in advance, I am new to programming in R.

Sean

messages.author: 7f0257cd1389289f
messages.subject: Re: Issues installing natverse
parts:
I missed this query at the time, but responding now for others. As you can see there is a problem with installation of the units package, a low-level dependency of the natverse. I have not encountered this myself. Installing this directly: 

install.packages('units')

could get round the problem (in which case restart the natverse install) or at least yield some clues.

Best,

Greg.
